letter.text:
[DATE]

Appeals Department

Re: Appeal of timely filing denial
Member ID: M-71442
Claim number: CLM-87990314
Payer claim number: 26273-002950
Original payer claim control number: 25203-114872
Date of service: 2025-07-14
Remittance date: 2026-10-16

To the Appeals Department:

[PRACTICE NAME] requests reconsideration of the following lines, both denied for timely filing:

Line 1: 99396, preventive visit, billed $245.00, denied CO-29
Line 2: 36415, routine venipuncture, billed $18.00, denied CO-29

The plan's timely filing policy, DEMO-ADM-010, states: "Claims must be received within 365 days of the date of service." For the 2025-07-14 date of service, that limit ended 2026-07-14. Claim 26273-002950 was resubmitted on 2026-09-30, after the limit. However, the original claim reached the plan well within the limit.

Our submission history shows the claim was sent on 2025-07-18. On 2025-07-22 it records: "277CA received from plan: claim accepted for adjudication. Payer claim control number 25203-114872." This acceptance date is inside the 365-day filing limit. On 2025-12-09, a status inquiry found that the plan had no claim on file under that control number. After follow-up, we resubmitted the claim, and it received the new number 26273-002950.

Policy DEMO-ADM-010 states: "The plan will reconsider a claim denied for timely filing when the provider submits proof that the original claim was received within the filing limit." It also states: "Acceptable proof is a claim acknowledgment (277CA) from the plan showing the payer claim control number and an acceptance date within the filing limit." The plan's 277CA acceptance of the original claim, dated 2025-07-22 under control number 25203-114872, is that proof. It shows the plan's own acceptance, not just a record that the claim was sent.

We ask the plan to reverse the CO-29 denials on lines 1 and 2 and process both lines for payment. Please contact our office if you need anything further.

Sincerely,

[PROVIDER NAME, CREDENTIALS]
[PRACTICE NAME]

Enclosures:
1. Remittance for claim CLM-87990314 / payer claim number 26273-002950, dated 2026-10-16
2. Claim submission history (practice billing system), dated 2026-10-20
